title: From XXLTraffic to EvoXXLTraffic: Scaling Traffic Forecasting to Sensor-Evolving Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.29768v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Traffic forecasting benchmarks commonly fix the sensor set, although deployed sensing networks change their coverage over time. We present EvoXXLTraffic, a sensor-evolving extension of the XXLTraffic dataset family, with yearly sensor catalogs, persistent station IDs, flow matrices, and geographic graph snapshots across nine California PeMS districts, spanning up to 27 years. The benchmark separates all-sensor forecasting from supervised adaptation to sensors absent from the preceding year. We evaluate 13 baseline adaptations on PEMS04 with five seeds and PEMS05 with three seeds, and seven of them on the other seven districts with three seeds. Each yearly task uses 31 stored days, explicit observation masks, and chronological evaluation. translated_title: 从XXLTraffic到EvoXXLTraffic：将交通预测扩展到传感器演化网络
translated_abstract: 交通预测基准通常固定传感器集合，然而实际部署的传感网络会随时间改变其覆盖范围。我们提出了EvoXXLTraffic，这是XXLTraffic数据集家族的传感器演化扩展版本，包含年度传感器目录、持久站点ID、流量矩阵以及覆盖加利福尼亚州九个PeMS区域的地理图快照，时间跨度长达27年。该基准将全传感器预测与针对前一年未出现传感器的监督适应任务区分开来。我们在PEMS04上使用五个随机种子、在PEMS05上使用三个随机种子评估了13种基线适应方法，并在其他七个区域上使用三个随机种子评估了其中七种方法。每个年度任务使用31个存储日期的数据、显式观测掩码和按时间顺序的评估。在冻结配置下，PECPM在PEMS04的全传感器群体和新节点群体上均取得最低的全时域平均MAE，而Online-AN则在PEMS05的这两个群体上均处于领先地位。
tldr: 提出了EvoXXLTraffic，一个传感器网络随年份演化的交通预测基准数据集，覆盖加州九个PeMS区域长达27年，用于同时评估全传感器预测和对新增传感器的适应能力。
en_tdlr: EvoXXLTraffic extends the XXLTraffic benchmark with yearly sensor-evolving networks across nine California PeMS districts spanning up to 27 years, enabling evaluation of both all-sensor forecasting and supervised adaptation to newly added sensors.
